pages.title: Panspermia Seed
pages.text: A seed packed with life designed to survive the trip between universes. Tardigrade toughness, a spark of life and unbihexium shielding, all sealed in a capsule that seems to hold a small universe of its own. It is light and very still.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Panspermia supposes life travels between worlds. I wanted it to travel between universes. The Abiogenesis Crucible sealed a spark of life with tardigrades, Xenoplasm and primordial soup inside a bubble universe shielded by unbihexium.
Made in $(item)Abiogenesis Crucible$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Panspermia.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnicellular Genome, Omnilex Seal, Transfinite Lattice Bolt.
